selected_evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the locally stored signed RPM and generated repodata, persistent repository configuration, active/enabled Apache, and HTTP 200 metadata response.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install a package without the usual remote repositories
selected_evidence.summary: Proves tree was initially absent, only local-offline was permitted for the cache-free transaction, and tree was installed and executed successfully from that repository.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 3aee314b-4dfc-4c3a-90f6-2b07c621eaa0, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 9ac30131-2adc-49ef-b784-d1b4495fbf21, and recovered HTTP listener, HTTP 200 repository metadata, local RPM/repodata, and installed executable.
